location_description:
La Mesa (Spanish for 'The Table') is a city in San Diego County, located nine miles (14 kilometers) east of Downtown San Diego in Southern California. The population was 57,065 at the 2010 census, up from 54,749 at the 2000 census. Its civic motto is "the Jewel of the Hills."


== History ==

La Mesa in Spanish means "the table", or alternately "the plateau", relating to its geography.
